title: Clem Andor
description: Clem Andor was a mechanic and salvager from Ferrix. he was married to Maarva Andor. The pair adopted Cassian Andor, whom they found on the planet Kenari. Unfortunately, Clem was executed by the Galactic Empire after a violent protest on Ferrix. After Luthen Rael recruited Cassian for a mission, he chose to use his father's first name as an alias.
